summary: Russian forces launched a massive combined strike on Ukraine overnight, including ballistic missiles hitting Kyiv killing one and injuring two, alongside hundreds of Shahed/Geran-5 drones and reactive UAVs penetrating deep into western regions. Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets across at least ten oblasts while Ukrainian forces struck Russian drone facilities and repair bases in occupied Donetsk and Luhansk. US intelligence warns of an imminent larger ballistic missile barrage within 48 hours.
key_points: Ballistic missiles from Smolensk struck Kyiv at 23:00 killing one, injuring two, damaging schools, a hospital, and a metro station. (Source: @eRadarrua/124295)
Russia launched 5 drone groups from Bryansk (2 reactive) and 6 reactive groups from Orel targeting northern and central Ukraine. (Source: @eRadarrua/124274)
Geran-5 rockets and reactive Shaheds tracked across Zhytomyr, Rivne, Volyn, Kyiv, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77205)
Ukrainian strikes hit Russian drone launch site in Donetsk, vehicle repair base in Suhodilsk (Luhansk), personnel concentration in Dubove (Donetsk). (Source: @eRadarrua/124261)
Multiple Iskander-M launch alerts from Bryansk region reported throughout the night. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77210)
US intelligence warns of imminent massive strike with 24 ballistic missiles (S-400, Iskander, Onyx, Zircon) and strategic aviation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84749)
Ukrainian drones attacked Saint Petersburg hitting cable bridge, oil terminal, VK data center, substation; Pulkovo restrictions; power outages. (Source: @UkraineNow/84732)
Air raid alerts active across Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Volyn, Chernihiv, Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Mykolaiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77205)

Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets across at least ten oblasts while Ukrainian forces struck Russian drone facilities and repair bases in occupied Donetsk and Luhansk. US intelligence warns of an imminent larger ballistic missile barrage within 48 hours.

points: Ukrainian forces conducted precision strikes on Russian military infrastructure in occupied territories: destroyed drone launch/storage site in Donetsk, hit vehicle repair base in Suhodilsk (Luhansk), and struck personnel concentration in Dubove (Donetsk) per General Staff report. (Source: @eRadarrua/124261)

Ukrainian long-range drones executed a major overnight attack on Saint Petersburg targeting critical infrastructure: cable bridge, oil terminal in port, VK data center, and electrical substation near Pulkovo airport causing power outages and flight restrictions. (Source: @UkraineNow/84732)

Ukrainian air defense units actively engaged incoming Russian drones and missiles across at least ten oblasts including Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Volyn, Chernihiv, Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Vinnytsia, and Khmelnytskyi throughout the night. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77205)

Ukrainian monitoring channels (eRadar, mon1tor, kpszsu) provided real-time tracking of Russian drone routes and missile launches, enabling civilian warnings and defensive coordination across multiple regions simultaneously. (Source: @eRadarrua/124273)

Russian forces launched ballistic missiles (likely Iskander-M) from Smolensk region at approximately 23:00 striking Kyiv's Dniprovskyi and Desnianskyi districts, killing one civilian, injuring two, damaging educational buildings, a medical facility, and a metro station. (Source: @eRadarrua/124295)

Massive drone attack initiated from Russian territory: 5 groups from Bryansk (including 2 reactive UAV groups) and 6 reactive groups from Orel, plus additional launches from Kursk direction targeting Chernihiv and Sumy regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/124274)

Geran-5 rockets and reactive Shahed-136/131 drones penetrated deep into western Ukraine following complex routes: from Zhytomyr to Rivne/Sarny, from Chernihiv to Kyiv/Vyshhorod, from Rivne to Volyn/Lutsk, from Kyiv to Zhytomyr/Korosten, from Mykolaiv to Kirovohrad, from Cherkasy to Kyiv/Bila Tserkva, from Kirovohrad to Cherkasy/Uman. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77205)

Repeated high-threat alerts for Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region issued throughout the night indicating sustained missile readiness and potential for follow-on strikes. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77210)
Ukrainian strikes in occupied Donetsk region targeted Russian drone launch and storage facility, degrading enemy UAV operations capacity in the sector. (Source: @eRadarrua/124261)
In Luhansk region, Ukrainian forces struck Russian vehicle repair base in Suhodilsk used by 'Yug' army group for maintenance of armored vehicles and combat equipment. (Source: @eRadarrua/124261)
Ukrainian attack on personnel concentration area in Dubove (Donetsk region) inflicted casualties on Russian occupation forces. (Source: @eRadarrua/124261)
No Russian ground offensive activity reported in eastern front messages; focus remains on long-range strike capabilities and air defense suppression. (Source: @eRadarrua/124261)
Russian drone launches from Bryansk region (5 groups, 2 reactive) and Kursk direction targeted Chernihiv and Sumy regions with strike and reconnaissance UAVs. (Source: @eRadarrua/124274)
Chernihiv region tracked 3 strike UAV groups and 1 reactive group; Sumy region tracked 3 strike UAV groups per radar monitoring. (Source: @eRadarrua/124273)
Reactive drones from Bryansk crossed into northern Chernihiv region heading toward Slavutych and Kyiv region via Chernobyl exclusion zone. (Source: @kpszsu/88130)
Multiple Geran-5 rockets from Chernihiv region redirected toward Kyiv region (Vyshhorod district) and Zhytomyr region (Korosten district) indicating flexible retargeting. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77205)
Russian strike UAV detected over Mykolaiv region heading toward Ochakiv from Black Sea waters. (Source: @kpszsu/88125)
Reactive drones from Mykolaiv region targeted Kirovohrad region (Kropyvnytskyi district) and circled near Voznesensk. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77205)
Ukrainian air defense engaged Russian drones over Mykolaiv and Kherson regions; strike UAV reported in Kherson region. (Source: @eRadarrua/124254)
No major Russian naval or amphibious activity reported; southern front activity limited to drone strikes and reconnaissance. (Source: @eRadarrua/124254)

Unprecedented scale of Russian drone attack: Geran-5 rockets and reactive Shaheds simultaneously tracked across 12+ oblasts using complex routing to saturate air defenses and penetrate western Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77205)

Ballistic missile component: at least 4 ballistic missiles launched at Kyiv (2 initially, then 2 more) with impacts in Borshchahivka, Vyradny, Sviatoshyn, and left bank districts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77215)
Russian drone launch sites: Bryansk (5 groups), Orel (6 reactive groups), plus additional launches from occupied territories and Russian border regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/124274)
Ukrainian air defense coordination across multiple sectors with real-time tracking from monitoring channels enabling sector-based engagement of incoming threats. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77217)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia has demonstrated capability to conduct simultaneous massed drone and ballistic missile strikes across the entire depth of Ukraine, utilizing complex routing to overwhelm air defenses. The use of reactive UAVs for reconnaissance and targeting correction alongside Geran-5 attack drones indicates evolving tactics. The confirmed ballistic missile strike on Kyiv from Smolensk (500+ km range) and persistent Iskander-M alerts from Bryansk suggest Russia maintains significant missile reserves and launch infrastructure. US warning of 24 additional ballistic missiles (including hypersonic Zircon and Onyx) within 48 hours signals potential for a major escalation targeting critical infrastructure. Ukrainian long-range strike capability against Russian rear areas (Saint Petersburg) remains effective but may provoke disproportionate retaliation.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian air defense and monitoring networks showed high coordination across multiple sectors, with real-time tracking enabling civilian warnings. However, the penetration of drones to western oblasts (Volyn, Rivne, Khmelnytskyi, Vinnytsia) reveals gaps in coverage density. The Saint Petersburg attack demonstrates Ukraine's growing strategic reach but risks triggering Russian attacks on Ukrainian decision-making centers. NATO and partner intelligence sharing (evidenced by US 48-hour warning) remains critical for early warning. Political rhetoric from Trump and Orban (per UkraineNow messages) reflects Western political fragmentation but does not immediately alter military dynamics.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian drone launch patterns show deliberate distribution across Bryansk, Orel, and Kursk axes to complicate interception. The use of "Banderol" (likely Lancet-type) loitering munitions alongside Shaheds suggests combined strike-reconnaissance packages. Ukrainian monitoring channels (eRadar, mon1tor, kpszsu) provide exceptional open-source situational awareness but may be targeted for degradation. The absence of reported Russian cruise missile (Kalibr, Kh-101) launches in this wave is notable; the ballistic missile component may be reserved for high-value targets. The 48-hour US warning window aligns with Russian missile preparation cycles observed previously.
